notes.title: General Improvements and Smooth Turn Speed
notes.notes:
Hi there,

Thank you so much for all your support! We’re excited about the feedback we received from you! We're working hard to improve [b]UNBINARY[/b] more and more.

This update features improvements including interface language, improved box interactions, puzzle adjustments, and a fix for masks issues.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Adjustment of SFX.
[*] Fixed the z-fighting issues on the menu.
[*] Improvement of the menu interface.
[*] Improvement of the physics on the keys.
[*] Improvement in the boxes fit system.
[*] Improvement on the voice-over sync.
[*] Fixed an issue on The Best We Can Be - 3, where the platform was too high.
[*] Adjustment of the smooth turn speed.
[*] Small tweaks and fixes.
[/list]

We hope these updates will improve your gameplay experience in UNBINARY.
Let us know in case you encounter any issues.

Official Discord server: https://discord.gg/WEyT2pk3Kh

Thanks for playing UNBINARY and see you next time!

notes.title: Interface Language and Fixes for Boxes, Puzzles and Masks
notes.notes:
Hello there,

We’ve been thrilled to see your reactions, impressions, and reviews for UNBINARY over the past month. Thank you so much for all your support! We’re excited to say that we’ve heard all your feedback and are happy to introduce this new update based on it.

This update features improvements including interface language, improved box interactions, puzzle adjustments, and a fix for masks issues.

[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added language option for game interface.
[*]Adjustment of different boxes interactions when grabbing and stacking them.
[*]Adjustment in the height of the first biometric scanner.
[*]Fixed an issue on Hacking the Privileges - 2, where the green robot behaved in an unwanted way.
[*]Fixed an issue where the tutorial was skipped when the option to play without subtitles was selected.
[*]Fixed an issue where a mask would disappear when dropped on the floor.
[*]Fixed an issue with false positives that occurred while solving some puzzles.
[*]Fixed a rare issue related to language selection.
[*]Small tweaks and fixes.[/list]


We hope these updates will improve your gameplay experience in UNBINARY.
Let us know in case you encounter any issues.

Official Discord server: https://discord.gg/WEyT2pk3Kh

Thanks for playing UNBINARY and see you next time!

notes.title: Locomotion Fixes and Smooth Turn Option
notes.notes:
Webby and the entire Ludact team are very excited with the reception UNBINARY is getting from all of you!

With the official launch of the game, we were very grateful to receive a lot of feedback, and today we announce the releasing of our first [b]official update[/b]!

[b]Patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Addition of the Smooth Turn option, accessible in the game menu.
[*]Fixed locomotion issues that generated small freezes during gameplay.
[/list]

One of the main points was that some players were suffering from locomotion issues during gameplay. As this is a problem that directly influences the player's experience, we decided to prioritize solving this specific problem in this update, and gladly we can report that the issue has been fixed.

And, in response to requests, we have also added a smooth turn option; it will be accessible through the game menu.

We would like to apologize to all players who have been affected by this in-game inconvenience and we hope your gaming experience becomes much more enjoyable now after this update!

At last, we invite everyone to join our Discord server! There you can have a good conversation, share your game experience, stay tuned for future updates, and make some new friends! 

[url=https://discord.gg/WEyT2pk3Kh]Official Discord server here[/url]!

Thank you all and see you in the next post!

notes.title: UNBINARY - Time to leave Early Access! Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]February 17, 2022[/b] was a really special day for us here at Ludact! Even Webby looked a little excited and unusually happy. ^^

It was with great pleasure that we announced that UNBINARY was fully released and is now available on the official Meta Quest Store, Rift Store, Viveport and Steam VR!

And we also invite you to watch our [b]new launch trailer[/b]:

[previewyoutube=Ull3HTPu2PA;full][/previewyoutube]

The idea and development of the game started in the distant year of 2018; since the first drafts, we faced countless challenges, dozens of uncertainties, and a worldwide pandemic during this journey.

Our decision to create a completely hand-painted game and work with pioneering technology in Virtual Reality proved to be a bit daunting, but very rewarding at the same time.
Being able to see the end result of the game today has made every effort worthwhile.

We thank you for all the support we received during this journey, all the feedback and criticism that has made us get better every day.

We hope you all have a lot of fun playing UNBINARY and that you can feel all the love and care of our team in every detail of the game.

For more information about our game (Stores, Social, Discord, Game Trailers, etc.), check out here: https://linktr.ee/UNBINARY
